capabilities: Pull wallpapers from image providers or local folders
Rotate backgrounds on intervals and time windows
Adjust background blur, brightness, saturation, and hue
Switch and save wallpapers from the status bar or command palette
Store provider API keys in Obsidian SecretStorage
disambiguation: It changes the editor's background image only, not theme colors or styling.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+; installable via BRAT as a beta plugin. Local images, colors, and gradients work offline; only provider features make network requests. Optimized for dark themes and may conflict with themes that define custom backgrounds. Roadmap mentions weather-driven sets, video/GIF and AI-generated backgrounds.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to use dynamic or rotating background images behind the editor, only static theme styling.

requires.name: Wallpaper provider API keys (Unsplash, Pixabay, Pexels, Wallhaven, custom)

summary: Wallpaper plugin that sets rotating note backgrounds from Unsplash, Pixabay, Pexels, Wallhaven, custom APIs, or local folders, with visual tuning controls.
